appraisal_events.evidence: je sortis... pour aller voir Mme Verdurin, car elle était, avec Mme Bontemps, une des reines de ce Paris de la guerre qui faisait penser au Directoire.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator introduces Mme Verdurin, together with Mme Bontemps, as one of the two reigning social 'queens' of wartime Paris, a status claim framed with the gentle irony of comparing the moment to the Directoire.

status_effects.explanation: She is named as one of the two social queens of the wartime moment, though this passage develops the claim no further.
She shares the same 'queen' status attributed to Mme Verdurin in this brief aside.
